title_as_printed: Remarks on the Language and Inhabitants of Lord North's Island, in the Indian Archipelago; with a Vocabulary
author: John Pickering
journal: Memoirs of the American Academy of Arts and Sciences, new series, vol. 2
heading_as_printed: A Vocabulary of the Language of Lord North's Island, called by the Natives Tóbi, in the Indian Archipelago; with Phrases and Dialogues in the Language.
collector: John Pickering, from the American seaman Horace Holden
about: Pickering compiled the vocabulary from information given by Horace Holden, an American seaman held captive with Benjamin Nute on Lord North's Island (Tobi) for about two years after a shipwreck.
